evidence_scope: photo identity, official documentation and offline protocol only
mapping_proposal: With all real cells removed and verified isolated sources at holder contacts, apply distinguishable voltages and change one position at a time; correlate raw cell1/cell7/cell13 response.
preconnection_requirements: Confirm lead remote ends and three pairs of mechanically stable insulated connections.
Verify empty-holder polarity and board stack connectivity; previous C-B-A order is inferred, not AFE mapping.
Plan power-off/removal/reconnection order including board supply, USB, ST-Link and battery energy; no live rewiring.
Real cells must not remain paralleled with bench outputs; charger and load disconnected.
Review AFE supply minimum, stack startup/shutdown and source reverse-current exposure before energizing.
Verify independent mode, output limits and stop path; do not tie channel negatives together or attach scope ground to stack taps.
